This snip adds a subtle transition to your expandos on your subverse. It fades in ever so slightly when expanded, so you may not even notice it, but it gives it more of a smooth style. It is implemented at /v/simplegoats when you press the + button to see the post. Just add it to the bottom of your CSS to implement.

This works in Chrome and IE, but I haven't tested on Firefox.

/* Adjust the expanded submission box a little and
 * add some animation to fit with the site.
 * This is when you click the plus button and the box
 * with the message expands. This is just the box that
 * has the message in it.
 */
@-webkit-keyframes fadeIn {
 from { opacity: 0; }
 to { opacity: 1; }
}

@keyframes fadeIn {
 from { opacity: 0; }
 to { opacity: 1; }
}
.expando {
 padding-right: 10px;
 -webkit-animation: fadeIn .2s;
 animation: fadeIn .2s;
}

This snip will group your sidebar buttons together, move your subverse name down (the rss feed), and move your subscriber text up. Just add to the bottom of your CSS and it should work. If it doesn't, come to /v/simplegoats and post about it. I had an issue applying it to one of my subverses, but I got it worked out.

You might have problems if you have moved other things around on the sidebar, but if you are using the default theme with my button sizing snip, this will work just like it does on this site. Without resizing the buttons, the sub/unsub and block buttons won't quite be in the right place.

/* Move RSS feed down */
.titlebox .hover {
 text-align: center;
 position: relative;
 top: 115px; /* if you are not using my button resize snip and using the default, this needs to be set around or at 60. */
}
/* Give the RSS link a place to start from */
#container > div.side > div:nth-child(4) > div > h1 > a.hover {
 position: relative;
 top: 0px;
}
/* Move the subscribers, buttons, and online people up */
.titlebox .subscribers,
.titlebox .users-online,
.side .btn-sub,
.side .btn-unsub,
.side .btn-whoaverse-paging {
 position: relative;
 top: -30px; /* This may need to be adjusted, depending on what is going on */
}
